pages.title: Overview, Features & Application Areas
highlights: RS-485 Modbus-RTU interface
SHT30 CMOSens capacitive humidity & energy-gap temperature chip
On-board DIP switch address setting; HVAC, cleanroom, pharma & warehouse applications

sections.heading: Product Overview & Features
sections.verified_excerpt: RS-485 bus Modbus-RTU protocol transmitter integrating SHT30 temperature and SHT3X capacitive humidity sensing with on-board 8-bit DIP address switch.

pages.title: Technical Data: Power, RS-485, Temperature & Humidity
highlights: Power: DC 5~24V, 5mA
RS-485: 4800/9600/19200 bps, 1200m max distance, 32 theoretical nodes
Humidity (SHT3X): 5~95%RH, res 0.1%RH, ±2%RH, ~8s response, <±0.25%RH/yr drift

sections.heading: Electrical & Sensing Specifications
sections.verified_excerpt: Supply DC 5~24V (5 mA); RS-485 4800/9600/19200 bps up to 1200 m; Temperature SHT30 -40~125 degC (res 0.1 degC, +/-0.3 degC at 0~60 degC); Humidity SHT3X 5~95 %RH (res 0.1 %RH, +/-2 %RH).

pages.title: Environmental Conditions, 4-Lead Wiring & PC Bus Schematic
highlights: Working/Storage environment: -40~85°C / 5~95%RH (Non-condensing)
Leads: Green = B-, Yellow = A+, Black = GND, Red = V+
Common-mode voltage warning: tie sensor GND and cable shield to RS-232/RS-485 transverter ground

sections.heading: 4-Lead Wiring & RS-485 Common-Mode Grounding
sections.verified_excerpt: Red = Power V+ (DC 5~24V), Black = Public GND, Yellow = RS-485 A+, Green = RS-485 B-. Bond sensor Black GND and cable shield to RS-232/RS-485 transverter ground.

pages.title: 8-Bit DIP Switch Address Code, 2-Step Opening & Data Frame Format
highlights: First Step: unscrew waterproof terminal nut; Second Step: unscrew barrel to access DIP switch
Default serial frame: 1 start bit, 8 data bits, 0 parity, 1 stop bit (8N1)

sections.heading: 8-Bit DIP Switch Address & 2-Step Housing Opening
sections.verified_excerpt: First Step: unscrew rear waterproof terminal nut. Second Step: unscrew middle barrel seam to access SW1 8-position DIP switch (weights 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1; e.g. Pins 1,3,4 ON = 176; Pin 8 ON = 1). Serial frame 8N1.

pages.title: RTU Frame Timing & Holding Register Map
highlights: >=3.5 char frame boundary; >1.5 char inter-byte gap causes silent drop
0x0000 Temp (0.1°C) & 0x0001 RH (0.1%RH) — 7FFF H means sensor is abnormal
0x0004 DIP Address (R), 0x0005 Baud Rate 4800/9600/19200 (R/W), 0x0006 HW ver, 0x0007 SW ver

sections.heading: RTU Timing & Holding Register Map (0x0000..0x0007)
sections.verified_excerpt: 0x0000 Temperature (0.1 degC signed, 7FFFH = abnormal), 0x0001 Relative Humidity (0.1 %RH, 7FFFH = abnormal), 0x0004 Address Code (R), 0x0005 Baud Rate (R/W), 0x0006 HW Version, 0x0007 SW Version.

pages.title: Modbus Poll Example & Function Code 03 Read Request/Response
highlights: Function 0x03 host request: 01 03 00 00 00 08 44 0C
21-byte response frame layout for registers 0x0000..0x0007

sections.heading: Function Code 0x03 Poll Request & 21-Byte Response
sections.verified_excerpt: Master read request for Slave 1 registers 0x0000..0x0007: 01 03 00 00 00 08 44 0C. Sensor replies with 21-byte RTU frame including 16 data bytes and trailing little-endian CRC-16.

pages.title: Data Decoding Example, Function Code 06 Baud Write & Abnormal Response
highlights: Function 0x06 set 9600 bps: 01 06 00 05 25 80 82 FB
Abnormal response sets function code MSB to 1 (0x83 / 0x86)

sections.heading: Register Decoding Example, Function 0x06 Baud Write & Exceptions
sections.verified_excerpt: Example: 00FAH = 25.0 degC, 0258H = 60.0 %RH, 2580H = 9600 bps, 000AH = V1.0. Function 0x06 baud write applies only to register 0x0005; abnormal replies set function MSB to 1 (0x83/0x86).

pages.title: Exception Error Codes, CRC-16 Algorithm & Mechanical Dimensions
highlights: Error codes: 01 Illegal function, 02 Illegal data address, 03 Illegal data value
CRC-16 init 0xFFFF, right-shift XOR polynomial 0xA001
Physical envelope: 140 MM length x 16 MM diameter (16.0 mm OD)

sections.heading: Exception Codes, CRC-16 (0xA001) & 140x16 mm Dimensions
sections.verified_excerpt: Exception codes: 01 Illegal Function, 02 Illegal Data Address, 03 Illegal Data Value. CRC-16 init 0xFFFF, right-shift XOR 0xA001. Envelope: 140.0 mm total length x 16.0 mm outer diameter.
